name: Healthy Minds Program
one_liner: Free, donation-funded meditation app from Humin, built on University of Wisconsin–Madison research, with short practices and lessons.
best_for: People who want a free, research-based meditation program
Busy people who prefer short or on-the-go practice
Learning the why behind meditation, not just the how
not_for: People looking for treatment for a diagnosed condition
short_description: A free meditation app with guided practices and podcast-style lessons on awareness, connection, insight and purpose, tested in randomized trials.
long_description: The Healthy Minds Program is a meditation app from Humin (formerly Healthy Minds Innovations), a nonprofit linked to the University of Wisconsin–Madison's Center for Healthy Minds. It offers short guided and unguided meditations, podcast-style lessons organised around awareness, connection, insight and purpose, 'active' practices you can do while walking or doing chores, wellbeing assessments and Apple Health mindful minutes. It is free with no subscription and funded by donations. The app has been tested in randomized trials: in a 2020 trial of 343 adults, eight weeks of the app reduced psychological distress more than a waitlist, and in a 2022 trial with over 600 school-system employees during COVID-19 it reduced distress compared with a waitlist.
patient_summary: You pick a short guided meditation or a podcast-style lesson, and can also do 'active' practices while walking or doing chores. It's free with no subscription, and you can donate if you want. It's a self-help tool for stress and wellbeing, not treatment for a diagnosed condition.

pricing.notes: Free with no subscription; funded by donations.

faqs.q: How much does Healthy Minds Program cost?
faqs.a: Free (donation-supported). Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Healthy Minds Program before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Healthy Minds Program replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Healthy Minds Program is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Healthy Minds Program?
faqs.a: Healthy Minds Program is available on iPhone and Android.

faqs.q: What does Healthy Minds Program include?
faqs.a: Guided and unguided meditations; Podcast-style lessons; Active practices for daily life; Wellbeing assessments; Apple Health mindful minutes.

citation.title: Testing the Efficacy of a Multicomponent, Self-Guided, Smartphone-Based Meditation App: Three-Armed Randomized Controlled Trial
